item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate – Deathwatch Announce Trailer | Warhammer Skulls 2026
item.description:
Take direct command of an elite Deathwatch Kill Team in the next chapter of the brutal, turn-based tactical RPG Chaos Gate saga! Lead your Deathwatch Space Marines into battle against the enemies of Humanity, supported by devoted agents of the Inquisition and Astra Militarum. Wage eternal war across hostile worlds, drive back deadly xenos hordes and resist the insidious and corrupting forces of Chaos.
In the grim darkness of the far future, every decision matters.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 – Purgation Update Trailer | Warhammer Skulls 2026
item.description:
Today’s Patch 13 comes with a new PvE mission, a major update to Siege Mode, and whole new sets of weapon and armour cosmetics, both free and paid.
Focus Entertainment and Saber Interactive are excited to announce the release of the Purgation Update for their 2024 action game Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 at today’s Warhammer Skulls festival. Available now free for all PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, and PC players, this update brings a host of free content and the long-awaited Iron Hands Chapter Pack.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000 Video Game Crossover Event – Tacticus and Dawn of War IV | Warhammer Skulls 2026
item.description:
War escalates in Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus with the Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV crossover!
Take on the Primarch of the Dark Angels, Lion El’Jonson, as he enters the fray as a new Guild Raid boss in Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. Plus, characters from Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV arrive as playable Champions with Blood Ravens Scout Master, Captain Cyrus, and the time-bending Necron Chronomancer Thothmek.
Build up your warband, enter new battles and face the evolving threats. Will you end the Necron threat in time or see the organic invaders purged? Play now!

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV - Release Date & Post-Launch Roadmap Reveal Trailer
item.description:
PRE-ORDER NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/22...
Just announced at Warhammer Skulls 2026, Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV launches on September 17th, 2026!
Join us as we break down everything you need to know, from release date and pre-orders to the different game editions available, plus a look ahead at the exciting content coming your way in our Year One Expansion Roadmap.
Alongside two paid DLCs, The Blood Ravens Story Prologue and AFTERMATH, you can also expect a range of free post-launch content updates, including the return of fan-favourite Crusade mode later this year!
The Commander Edition includes: 3-day early unlock (play starting September 14th) The Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV Digital soundtrack Access to both upcoming paid DLCs (The Blood Ravens Story Prologue and AFTERMATH)
Pre-orders are now live with a special 10% discount on both the Standard and Commander Editions, so be sure to secure your copy: https://store.steampowered.com/app/22...
